title: Home collection
seo_description: Home sample collection software: assign bookings to phlebotomists, track visits on a live map, send patients automatic SMS updates, and move samples straight into tracking.

fields.hero_title: Run home collection without the phone calls
fields.hero_lead: Assign bookings to phlebotomists, follow every visit on a live map, and keep patients updated automatically, so your front desk stops answering “where is the rider?” calls.
fields.features:
Bookings by status: pending, en route, in progress, done
Live phlebotomist location and ETA
Automatic SMS updates to patients
Who is on duty, at a glance
Address and tests on every visit card
Collected samples move straight into tracking

steps.title: Book and assign
steps.text: Bookings go to the right phlebotomist, with the address and tests on each visit card.

steps.title: Track the visit
steps.text: Follow every visit on a live map while patients get automatic updates.

steps.title: Hand off to the lab
steps.text: Collected samples move straight into sample tracking when they arrive.

fields.cta_title: See home collection with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
